board: North Carolina State Board of CPA Examiners

cycle.note: CPE is due by December 31 every year: 40 hours (2,000 minutes), including 1 hour of ethics. Up to 20 extra hours carry forward to the next year. You report at license renewal by June 30.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: 40 hours (2,000 minutes) by December 31 (21 NCAC 08G .0401). Up to 20 hours over last year's requirement carry forward.

requirements.label: Professional ethics
requirements.note: At least 50 minutes a year of regulatory or behavioral professional ethics from a NASBA-registered sponsor. Carried-forward hours can't meet it.

newLicensee.note: The year your certificate was approved needs fewer hours: April–June 30, July–Sept 20, Oct–Dec 10 (21 NCAC 08G .0401). Courses earlier that year count.

licenseDateHint: North Carolina licenses renew every year by June 30. CPE is tracked by calendar year regardless.
issueDateHint: If your certificate was approved this year, this year's hours are reduced by the month it was approved.
limitsNotTracked: Instruction, college courses and CPE technical review combined: max 50% of the minutes.
Published materials: max 25% of the minutes.
Ethics minutes can't be carried forward to meet next year's ethics.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for the current year and the four calendar years before it.
toVerify: The 1-hour ethics still applies in the year the certificate was approved (the rule says 'annually').
Carryforward measured over the year's requirement (the reduced one in the licensure year).
